surface_note: A wrapping row of cards, ONE PER REVIEW SOURCE, not one per review. Each card carries a platform logo, a label, a score with stars, and a review count. No individual review is rendered on the resting surface. Card Layout has a surface and a score numeral; Award Layout has neither, no platform logo and no rating chip, and its stars carry the rating alone.
known_limitation: The Award Layout renders no platform logo, no card surface and no score numeral, but layout is chosen per widget at runtime and the config is resolved per widget TYPE, so those cannot be dropped mechanically here. The REVIEW_BADGE pre-analysis block in promptBuilder.js instructs the model not to fail an Award Layout for them.
